name: Breaka Boyz
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 2nd unit 120 pts for 6 models; 3rd+ unit 130 pts for 6 models.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1 Nob model, 5 Breaka Boy models. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_loadout: The Nob is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Rokkit Pistol; 1 Smash Hammer. Every Breaka Boy is equipped with: 1 Smash Hammer.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.

_wargearOptions_note: Printed as: The Nob can have their Smash Hammer replaced with 1 Rokkit Pistol. | 1 Breaka Boy model can have their Smash Hammer replaced with 1 Knucklebustas. | 1 Breaka Boy model can have their Smash Hammer replaced with 1 Tankhammer.
